highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 updates the rendering engine to Skia m150 and expands image, color, and paint APIs.
highlights_body: The release also improves repeated SKSurface canvas access, corrects small-sigma raster blurs, and completes the pre-v4 API cleanup.

breaking.title: Remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs are now errors
breaking.body: APIs that remained obsolete from before v4 now produce compile errors, and obsolete enums are absent from the reference assembly. Migrate callers to the replacement APIs identified by their obsolete messages before upgrading.

breaking.title: .NET Interactive support removed
breaking.body: The deprecated .NET Interactive and Polyglot Notebooks integration is no longer shipped. Remove dependencies on that integration or move notebook rendering to an application-owned SkiaSharp display path.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to the m150 release line and includes a subsequent round of upstream m150 bug fixes.

bullets.lead: Image and color filter creation expanded
bullets.detail: Adds empty and crop image filters plus an overdraw color filter for composing filter graphs and visualizing overdraw.
Adds SKPaint.GetFastBounds() so callers can cheaply estimate draw bounds for quick-reject culling.
Restores expected output for small-sigma raster blurs that regressed on the m150 line.
Caches the managed Canvas wrapper across calls, avoiding repeated wrapper creation while preserving the surface-owned canvas lifecycle.
Refreshes the bundled text-shaping dependency used by HarfBuzzSharp.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Pre-v4 obsolete API cleanup, faster SKSurface canvas access, and the small-sigma raster blur fix

harfbuzz_summary: Refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz text-shaping engine to 14.2.1.

v4.150.0-preview.1.1.subtitle: Previews SkiaSharp 4.150 on the Skia milestone 150 rendering engine.
v4.150.0-preview.1.1.website_summary: Preview 1 opened the 4.150 line with the Skia m150 engine update.

bullets.text: Updated the Skia engine to milestone 150

v4.150.0-preview.2.1.subtitle: Finalizes the v4 obsolete-API cleanup, removes .NET Interactive support, and refreshes HarfBuzz.
v4.150.0-preview.2.1.website_summary: Preview 2 completed the pre-v4 obsolete API cleanup, removed deprecated .NET Interactive support, and updated HarfBuzz to 14.2.1.

bullets.text: Promoted remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs to errors and trimmed obsolete enums from the reference assembly
Removed deprecated .NET Interactive and Polyglot Notebooks support

v4.150.0-rc.1.1.subtitle: Adds image-filter and color-filter APIs, speeds up SKSurface canvas access, and corrects raster blur rendering.
v4.150.0-rc.1.1.website_summary: Release Candidate 1 added new image-filter, color-filter, and paint-bounds APIs while improving SKSurface canvas access and small-sigma raster blurs.

bullets.text: Cached the SKSurface.Canvas wrapper across calls for faster access
Fixed the small-sigma raster blur rendering regression
